about: Field Cogitator design data. `language` summarises the design language (token groups in src/language/tokens.css, layout numbers in src/language/layout.ts). `elements.sections` lists the Elements view's sections and entries in page order; the Elements page renders from this list, so a new primitive needs an entry here and a renderer there. Everything is a Proposal on Next until the user approves it (next-track.json).
source: D4 step 2, design language (2026-11-22), extracted from Direction D

language.scope: An element with .fc-cg and .light or .dark; macOS is the base layer, [data-platform="windows"] the Windows layer, [data-text="large"] large text (1.25×).

groups.title: Colour
groups.note: Semantic names; status colours always come with a shape (edge or icon).

groups.title: State mixes
groups.note: Mixes of ink or accent, so every theme gets them; Windows presses with a fill, macOS with a filter.

platforms.windows: Segoe UI Variable, 14 px working text

groups.title: Spacing
groups.note: 4 px grid with D's half steps (6, 10, 14, 18).

rowsInView.note: Source list rows without group headings; Iron Wardens (4 headings, 13 rows) fits on both.

platforms.mac: 6 px controls, 9 / 12 px floating, 12 px window
platforms.windows: 4 px controls, 8 px floating and window

groups.title: Elevation
groups.note: Only floating things are raised: pill, helper box, popovers, menus, palette, dialogs (no-card rule).

groups.title: Motion
groups.note: Layout changes 0.2 s, small feedback 0.12 s; zero with reduced motion.

platforms.mac: 2 px accent ring inside the control
platforms.windows: 2 px ink ring 1 px outside the control

groups.title: Syntax colours
groups.note: DKLPO text in the source editor (E1 part B): keywords, declaration keys (ink, weight 600), references (the mention accent), strings and text values, comments (italic), numbers and ranges. Each 4.5:1 or more on the pane in its theme; diagnostics keep the status colours.

groups.title: Layout
collapseOrder: Below 1358 px: helper panel becomes the floating box
Below 1322 px: floating box becomes the pill

entries.title: Window frame and title row
entries.from: Direction D; Windows frame new (Battle Augur RK-03 style)
entries.summary: macOS: traffic lights in the sidebar's top row, 12 px corners. Windows: no menu bar; the dataset switcher moves up into the title row, Windows' own caption buttons (46 px, the header's height) sit at the far right, 8 px corners.

entries.title: Sidebar item
entries.summary: 28 px rows on the surface paper. Active (the source shown in the list) is the selection tint; current (the open entry) is bold with an accent icon, no fill.

entries.title: Source group heading
entries.summary: Caption size, weight 600, sentence case, the count in regular weight; a chevron folds the group. Space above it separates groups, no hairline.

entries.title: Source row
entries.summary: Glyph, name, changed dot, cost and diagnostic in fixed columns under the column heads; the status edge anchors the row. Costs in tabular figures, right-aligned.

entries.title: Filter field
entries.summary: A quiet filled field (hover fill), the focus ring inside it; Esc clears it.

entries.title: Buttons
entries.from: Direction D; disabled and Windows pressed states new
entries.summary: Primary (accent), quiet (hover fill), small (in rows), ghost (toolbar, icon + label + key) and icon buttons.

entries.title: Segmented control
entries.summary: Two scopes (This entry, Dataset) with counts; the selected one is the pane colour with a thumb shadow.

entries.title: Keycap
entries.summary: Micro size, hairline border, muted; macOS glyphs, Windows names.

entries.title: Breadcrumbs and page toolbar
entries.summary: Source / entry, then status text and the ghost buttons Focus and Source.

entries.title: Page title and backlinks
entries.summary: Kind glyph, title, backlinks as mentions; an entry without text shows its key in mono with a suggestion tag.

entries.title: Layer chip
entries.summary: Selection tint, accent text, micro weight 600: marks which layer a source or value comes from.

entries.title: Tags, mentions and the peek
entries.summary: Tags are hues mixed into the paper; a mention is an accent chip with ↗ that opens its entry; hover or focus shows the peek popover. A broken reference is red mono with a wavy underline.

entries.title: Property row
entries.summary: Label column (icon + label, muted) and a value cell that tints on hover; the properties block ends with a hairline.

entries.title: Statement block
entries.summary: Mono keyword, then the value; a chevron folds children; a flagged block gets a 2 px status edge and a faint tint while its diagnostic is open.

entries.title: Helper pill
entries.summary: The helper collapsed: counts by kind with their icons; click brings the box back.

entries.title: Floating helper box
entries.summary: This page's issues, suggestions and actions in the one raised object over the page margin; collapse to the pill or expand to the panel.

entries.title: Panel tabs and resize edge
entries.summary: Issues, Suggestions, Properties; the active tab is the press fill; issue counts in the error badge. The panel's left edge lights up in the accent when it can be dragged.

entries.title: Issue row
entries.summary: Status edge, message with code, where in mono; selected shows the fix as a primary small button (and Go to when elsewhere); done shows Undo.

entries.title: Empty states
entries.summary: One muted line with what is empty and the way out (Clear filter); a check in OK green when nothing is wrong.

entries.title: Exit focus and focus toggles
entries.summary: In focus mode the list header carries the window controls and Exit focus with its key; outside it, an icon button enters focus.

entries.title: / insert menu
entries.summary: Statements valid at the cursor with their syntax in mono; ↵ inserts the selected one.

entries.title: Command palette (⌘K)
entries.summary: Search entries and run commands: entries with glyph, key and cost, commands with their key; a dialog, so it floats with the dialog elevation.

entries.title: Context menu
entries.summary: Right-click or ⇧F10 on a row: verbs with targets, shortcuts as muted text, destructive last in error red.

entries.title: Large text (1.25×)
entries.from: New rule for Direction D's rows
entries.summary: Working text at 1.25×: rows grow from a minimum height, names wrap instead of truncating, costs keep their right-aligned column, property labels wrap.

entries.title: Recent-dataset row
entries.summary: Icon, title (with an Archive or Sample tag), folder, DKLPO version, layers on / total, last opened; the status edge is the last check’s worst kind. Selected, a second line shows the last check and the actions (Open, Show in Finder, Remove from the list) or, when missing, Locate… / Remove from the list.

entries.title: Progress row
entries.summary: A step of a longer job: status icon, label, count, and a thin accent bar while it runs.

entries.title: Drop target
entries.summary: A dashed outline that holds no content (not a card); turns into the selection tint while a folder or archive is dragged over it.

entries.title: Dialog and sheet
entries.from: New in E1 (open errors, editor dialogs)
entries.summary: What happened in one sentence, the file or folder, the choices as verbs; Return does the primary, Esc the safe choice. Floats with the dialog elevation over a scrim.

entries.title: Popover menu with sections
entries.from: The context menu, extended in E1 (dataset switcher)
entries.summary: The context menu, wider, with a head block for the open dataset, section labels and two-line items with a folder in mono.

entries.title: Settings row and controls
entries.summary: Label, control, help text. macOS: the classic preferences layout with checkboxes; Windows: label and help left, control right, switches with On / Off, radios stacked; no setting cards.

entries.title: Settings tabs and navigation list
entries.summary: macOS toolbar tabs (icon above label); Windows navigation list with the accent indicator bar.

entries.title: Shortcut list
entries.summary: Command and its keys as one keycap per key, grouped by task; read-only in E1.

entries.title: Code editor with gutter
entries.from: New (E1 part B), drawn from the tokens
entries.summary: Mono text with line numbers, a diagnostics gutter (the kind's icon), DKLPO syntax colours (--cg-syntax-*), underlines that differ by shape (error wavy, preservation dashed, suggestion dotted), the lines of the block selected on the page tinted with an accent edge, the caret line in the hover fill. A parse error shows under its line with its fix, edged like a flagged block.

entries.title: Text header and status line
entries.summary: Header: the file in mono, where the selection is, the view buttons (Text only / Page beside, close). Status line on the surface paper: counts by kind, caret position, fmt state (dot in OK green, amber or red), UTF-8, LF, indentation, DKLPO version.

entries.title: Diagnostic hover card and quick-fix menu
entries.from: New (E1 part B); the menu is the context menu primitive
entries.summary: Hovering an underline shows a popover with the kind, the code, the message and the fix as a button (the first fix primary, ⌥↵ / Alt+Enter). ⌥↵ at the caret opens the quick fixes as a menu: the first fix selected, the rest as verbs with targets.

entries.title: Linked statement block
entries.from: Direction D's statement block, plus the line link
entries.summary: In the split view a block is selected together with its lines: the block and its children take the selection tint and show their line number at the right edge; a flagged block keeps its status edge.

entries.title: New entry row and empty list
entries.summary: New entry (⌘N) opens an inline row in the source list, in the selection tint: the kind picker and the key field (the module prefix muted), validated as you type with the rule in plain words; Create is disabled while the key is wrong and says why. An empty list says what is empty and offers New entry with its key.

entries.title: Back and Forward
entries.summary: Two icon buttons at the start of the page toolbar, before the breadcrumbs: they name where they go in the tooltip and accessible name (Back to Warden Squad, ⌘[), and when there is no history they are disabled and say so.

entries.title: Peek frame
entries.summary: The target entry inline under the line that refers to it: an embedded view on the surface paper with a hairline frame and a 3 px accent edge (not raised). Header: glyph, name, path in mono, source and layer chip, Page / Text, Open (F12), Close (Esc). Edits save to the target's file, named in the footer.

entries.title: Backlinks tab
entries.from: Direction D's helper panel, a fourth tab
entries.summary: Every place that refers to the entry, grouped by source and layer (headings as in the issue lists); each row shows the referring line in syntax colours, a note with its glyph, and file:line; the selected row shows Open with ↵. The panel opens at 412 px for four tabs.

entries.title: No-definition popover
entries.summary: Go to definition on a reference that resolves to nothing: a popover at the reference says so (and that nothing was opened), names the closest key and offers the fix (⌥↵) or creating the entry.

entries.title: Inbox row and group heading
entries.from: Direction D's issue row, wider and two lines
entries.summary: Status edge, the message (code in mono), then the entry with its glyph, the source, a layer chip when it isn't Base, and the code at the right. Groups by kind under caption headings with counts, no hairlines. Done rows go muted with a check.

entries.title: Filter chips
entries.summary: Source, Layer and Code as pill chips: dashed while they show everything, tinted with the value and a clear button when set; each opens a menu with counts. A text filter on the left.

entries.title: Diff block and out-of-date note
entries.summary: The export difference of a preservation failure: a header (original → export, what changed), lines with a sign column and error / OK tints, wrapping long lines. The out-of-date note is an inline tinted row with the preservation edge and Run checks.

screens.title: Start window
screens.summary: No dataset open: app actions in the sidebar, recent datasets (title, folder, DKLPO version, layers on / total, last opened, status edge), a drop target. The selected row opens a second line with the last check and Open / Show in Finder / Remove from the list, or for a missing dataset Locate… / Remove from the list.
workflows: Open a recent dataset: select (click or ↑ ↓), Return or double-click; progress shows reading files, compiling and checking with counts; Esc cancels
Remove a recent dataset: ⌘⌫ (Delete on Windows) or the row action; Undo in the footer (⌘Z)
Missing dataset: Locate… points the row at its new folder, or remove it
Open folder… / Open file… / drop a folder or archive; a problem shows the open-errors dialog
Convert from XML data…: pick a folder of .gst / .cat files; the steps run with counts and the new dataset opens
First run: the empty state offers the three actions and the sample dataset

screens.title: Open errors
screens.summary: A sheet (macOS) or dialog with a footer band (Windows) over the start window: what happened, the folder, the choices as verbs; the primary takes Return, Cancel takes Esc.
workflows: Not a dataset: Convert… (XML data files found), Choose another folder…, Cancel
Newer DKLPO version: Open read-only (what the newer version added shows as source text, nothing saved) or Cancel
Files that do not parse: Open anyway (the files open as source text with their errors; their entries are left out) or Cancel
Folder not writable: Open read-only, Save as… elsewhere, or Cancel

screens.title: Window-level dialogs over the editor
screens.summary: Dataset switcher popover and the sheets for unsaved changes, a module changed on disk and a failed save, over a static Direction D window.
workflows: Switch dataset: Demo Skirmish ▾ opens the switcher; a recent dataset, Open…, Convert… or Close dataset; with unsaved changes the Save / Don’t save / Cancel sheet follows
Changed on disk without edits: Reload (primary), Keep mine (Esc), Compare
Changed on disk with edits: Compare (primary), Keep mine (Esc), Reload and discard my edits
Save failed: Retry (primary), Save as…, Cancel (Esc); edits stay in the editor

screens.title: Settings
screens.summary: Settings window, one state per section; macOS toolbar tabs, Windows navigation list; open rows of label, control and help text.
workflows: General: open the last dataset at start, recent list length, clear the recent list (Undo)
Editor: source text beside the page by default, / insert, format on save (fmt), font size
Checking: default check level lenient / strict (a dataset’s checking: wins), run checks on save, show authoring suggestions
Text: text pack language, how names without text show
Appearance: theme (system / light / dark), accent (system or app)
Keyboard: read-only shortcut list with a filter
Command line: engine, DKLPO and augur dklpo versions; copy the same check command

screens.title: Source text beside the page
screens.summary: Source (⌘⌥U) splits the page area into the entry page and its module's DKLPO text, synced both ways; text editor with gutter, syntax colours, diagnostic underlines, hover card, quick-fix menu (⌥↵) and status line. The split needs 1000 px of page area: the source list folds away while it is open, and in a 960 px window Source switches between page and text. A module that doesn't parse opens as text only.
workflows: Read an entry's text beside its page and select a statement in either
Fix an unknown reference from the quick-fix menu
Fix a parse error; the module's pages come back once it parses

screens.title: Go to definition, peek and backlinks
screens.summary: Go to definition (F12, ⌘-click, click) with Back / Forward (⌘[ / ⌘]) and breadcrumbs; Peek (⌥F12, ⌥-click) inline under the line, page or text, editable in place; Backlinks (⇧F12) as a fourth tab of the helper panel, grouped by source and layer, ↵ opens; an unresolved reference offers its fix instead of navigating.
workflows: Follow a reference and come back
Look at a referenced entry without leaving the page
Walk through every place that refers to an entry
Fix a reference that resolves to nothing

screens.title: Diagnostics inbox
screens.summary: Updates (⌘⇧U) opens the dataset's diagnostics as a full view in place of the list and the page; the helper box and panel stay the quick view beside a page and lead here with Open all. Grouped by kind, filters by source, layer and code, keyboard triage (↑ ↓, ↵ open, ⌥↵ fix), detail pane with the affected text or the export difference, bulk fix per suggestion code, out-of-date and clear states.
workflows: Triage every diagnostic of the dataset by keyboard
Apply one suggestion everywhere it occurs
Read a preservation failure's export difference
See that the list is out of date and run checks

screens.title: Editor empty states
screens.summary: A source with no entries (inline New entry with kind and key, the module text so far on the page side), an entry with no statements (the / hint as the first block, a name to add, no backlinks yet), and a search with no result (the palette says what it searched and skipped, and offers create, search with the off layer, clear).
workflows: Add the first entry to a new catalogue
Start an empty entry with its first statement
Recover from a search that finds nothing

screens.title: Run checks
screens.summary: The check status button in the page toolbar says what the last run found or that it runs or is out of date; ⌘⇧C or the button runs `check --with <layers>` and `export --dry-run --exact`, and the popover under it shows the steps with counts and Cancel, then the result per class (errors, preservation failures, authoring suggestions) with codes, what was checked and the command to copy. A dataset that doesn't compile stops before Lower and offers the fix.
workflows: Run the checks while editing and read the result per class
Open the inbox filtered by one class from the result
See that the results are out of date and run again
Fix a parse error that stops the run, then run again

screens.title: Convert from XML data
screens.summary: A window of its own: options as the convert command's flags in words on the left; the input's documents, the steps with counts and Cancel, then the report (C2 / C1 / C3 verdicts, numbers, C1 differences per document with class, path and before → after, preservation diagnostics, Open the converted dataset, commands to copy) on the right. Dry run writes nothing; an input that can't be read stops before writing.
workflows: Convert a folder of XML data files into a new dataset and open it
Read which documents don't come back exactly and why
Dry-run a conversion to see the report without writing
Recover from an input that can't be read

screens.title: Export
screens.summary: A sheet over the editor with format, destination, text language and the exactness from a dry run: exact (originals available, C3) or not exact with counts and each reason (preserve/stale, preserve/unbound, preserve/original-outdated); a non-exact export still writes unless Require an exact export (--exact) is on. The result lists the written files; a Level 1 construct refuses the export by name.
workflows: Export an unedited dataset exactly, or return the original files
Export an edited dataset and read which recorded details won't come back
Require an exact export and see why it refuses
Find the construct that stops an export

screens.title: Roundtrip
screens.summary: A tool view with the roundtrip command's two routes: from the XML data (C2 norm, C1 per document) and from this dataset (deterministic writing, import and compare, reconvert: ids and files). Left: contracts and documents with verdicts; right: the selected row's comparison and differences, the command to copy. A partly imported input stops before C2 and names the file.
workflows: Check that the dataset still round-trips to the XML data it came from
Read one document's source-tree differences
Check a dataset by the reverse route (write, import, reconvert)
Recover from an input that was only partly imported
